BE_setting: checked categorical BE, per-network 5th percentile threshold, retain ~95% edges, num_runs=10, seed=0
pairing: input network ID within condition; 20 matched networks in each panel
test: two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank; differences rounded to 12 decimals; zero differences omitted; tied ranks averaged
verification: Dynamic-programming null probabilities independently matched exhaustive sign reassignment; BH independently matched scipy.stats.false_discovery_control
multiplicity: 12 pairwise comparisons = 3 method pairs x 4 conditions; BH applied jointly
interpretation: Exploratory conditional comparison. Does not adjust for searching and selecting the BE threshold from the tested grid. Does not replace formal S09 or establish superiority over other BE settings.
